body_html:
What a night! This wedding was one for the memory books.. Congratulations to Scott and Laura Arledge! Wit JAMMIN’ DJs of Denver Georgia providing quality entertainment for weddings,corporate events you can have a night to remember too! We specialize in Weddings,Bar mitzvah’s,school dances, trivia ,Karaoke and much more! This couple had a great night of dancing followed with an interactive guest list that really knew how to have a good time!!! Can you say Conga line,limbo,break dancing and theater all in the same night. Wow what an honor it was to provide the performance for this couple. Best wishes to the both of you.

~Steve Smith~
